hook: Hold a real argument about car-free cities or working from home: state your view, report the critics, answer them, conclude.
intro: The closing conversation of this module, in your own AI assistant with voice on: a discussion on a social question — car-free cities, working from home, taxes — in which you present a position, report what others say, respond to counter-arguments and reach a conclusion. Copy the exercise in, say 'Los geht's', answer in full sentences; the score and corrections come at the end. The tutor listens for the markers of a mature argument: Redemittel of argument (Dafür spricht …, Das mag sein, aber …), the Konjunktiv I when you report (Kritiker sagen, das sei …), connectors at position 1 with the verb second (Allerdings …, Daher …), and at least one nominal cause (wegen der Kosten, aufgrund der Umfrage). This is a real discussion — the kind you have at work or with friends — in rehearsal.
tips[0].title: Position → report → respond → conclude
tips[0].text: Ich bin der Ansicht, dass … · Kritiker sagen zwar, das sei …, aber … · Das mag sein, allerdings … · Daraus folgt für mich, dass … Four moves per topic.
tips[0].check.why: Das mag sein concedes, allerdings brings your answer. The other lines are the position move and the conclusion.
tips[0].visual.moves[0].label: Position
tips[0].visual.moves[1].label: Report
tips[0].visual.moves[2].label: Respond
tips[0].visual.moves[3].label: Conclude
tips[1].title: Connector first, verb second — every time
tips[1].text: Allerdings sehe ich …, Daher schlage ich vor …, Außerdem sollte … Say the connector, then the verb, then the rest.
tips[1].check.why: Daher fills position 1, so the verb comes next and the subject follows: Daher schlage ich … vor.
tips[2].title: One nominal cause per answer
tips[2].text: wegen der hohen Kosten / aufgrund der Ergebnisse / dank der neuen Regelung — a genitive phrase instead of a weil-clause is the compact, formal move.
tips[2].check.why: aufgrund takes the genitive, and the genitive plural is der hohen Mieten.
remember[1]: wegen / aufgrund + Genitiv instead of weil, once per answer.
exam: Discussing a social question with a partner is a core speaking task in the B2 exam — and in any serious conversation in German.
